questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to go somewhere small, where the university plays a big role. And I also wanted to go as far south as possible, that thereby I could explore totally new areas

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Maybe a whole year was a bit much for such a small town.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Everything regarding information and practicalities has worked but has been unnecessarily stressful.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: The Studierendenwerk was very helpful. Also the Fachkoordinatorin und Lara Gmirek.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: I lived on Campus, but another Campus that the one, I was studying at. I guess, had I researched the locations a bit more, I would have lived on the Campus that was mine.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: A kitchen that I shared with 2-3 other students.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer: That it is hard to find a enjoyable place to live, as far as I know.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I really didn't enjoy my housing situation.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Super unintuitive and different for each course.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The teachers were super helpful, so it all worked out fine. And also the Fachkoordinatorin L. Wilwert.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes I wanted.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: To be fast in communicating, also to the home university. Sometimes they are mistrustful and it can be, that you have to argument over whether the courses are relevant.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took all sorts of courses. The level was extremely high, I really learned a lot.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The scandinavian pedagogicy of UCPH is non-present i Heidelberg. In Hei. it is much more Authoritarian, not necessarily in a bad way, but I'm looking forward to get back.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Projektseminar: Internationales Filmfestival Mannheim-Heidelberg
Politisches Theater der Kriegs- und Zwischenkriegsjahre
Schund- und Schmutzliteratur
Einführung in das literarische Werk W. G. Sebalds

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
questions.answer:
Heimito von Doderer, Die Dämonen.
Forschungskolloquium Albrecht

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hard to say, since it changes every year, but probably A. Albrechts courses.

questions.answer: Travelling a lot to and fro.

questions.answer: Cheap nuts.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: A lot: dancing, cinema, bars, theater (free for students), hiking etc.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hiking in the forest around and then bicycling the other direction.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Amorbach was cool.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: That was not so difficult. Very similar to Denmark in that regard.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None really. Not anything that has something to do with culture anyhow.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I enjoyed how much cash was used. And people are easy to talk to on the bus f.x.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: To start early with finding courses, and to communicate very fast with UCPH and the Host Uni, to avoid any problems.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The teachers are very loose with exchangestudents, so dont worry about the grades.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: I met my girlfriend!! And then I followed the courses of a crazy clever professor, who unfortunately is retiring soon.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The housing situation can be very shitty. I wish I had lived elsewhere.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
